prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
text: For years, city planners assumed that adding more lanes would ease traffic. Yet studies of several metropolitan areas found that new lanes quickly filled with additional cars, leaving travel times about the same. Some planners now argue that investing in public transit would do more to reduce congestion.
options: Widening roads often fails to reduce congestion, so some planners favor public transit.
City planners have never studied traffic patterns before.
Public transit is always faster than driving a car.
Adding lanes has solved traffic problems in every large city.
answer: Widening roads often fails to reduce congestion, so some planners favor public transit.

wrong.City planners have never studied traffic: 文中說明有研究調查過多個都會區，planners 並非從未研究。
wrong.Public transit is always faster than dri: 文中只說大眾運輸可能更能減少壅塞，沒有說一定比開車快，always 說得太絕對。
wrong.Adding lanes has solved traffic problems: 文章指出新增車道後車子很快又塞滿，旅行時間沒有改善，與此選項相反。

why: 文章先說明傳統想法，再用研究推翻，最後提出替代作法，主旨就是加寬道路效果有限，所以改看重大眾運輸。
tip: 主旨要涵蓋全文，不能只抓單一細節。
say: Widening roads often fails to reduce congestion, so some planners favor public transit.

prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
text: Many people think bees only make honey. In fact, bees pollinate roughly a third of the crops humans eat. (Without them, grocery stores would look very different.) Protecting bees is therefore an agricultural concern as well as an environmental one.
options: It illustrates the practical effect of the claim made in the previous sentence.
It challenges the claim made in the final sentence.
It introduces a new topic unrelated to bees.
It admits that the author's argument is weak.
answer: It illustrates the practical effect of the claim made in the previous sentence.

wrong.It challenges the claim made in the fina: 括號句和最後一句方向一致，都在強調保護蜜蜂的重要性，沒有挑戰最後一句。
wrong.It introduces a new topic unrelated to b: 括號句仍在談沒有蜜蜂的後果，與蜜蜂密切相關。
wrong.It admits that the author's argument is: 此句強化而不是削弱作者論點，文中沒有任何讓步。

why: 前一句說蜜蜂替大量作物授粉，括號句舉出沒有蜜蜂超市會有何不同，是在具體說明這個影響。
tip: 功能題看句子與前後句的關係。
say: Without them, grocery stores would look very different.

prompt: Which choice best states the central claim of the text?
text: Critics once dismissed graphic novels as shallow entertainment for children. But works such as Maus and Persepolis tackle war, memory, and identity with remarkable subtlety. These examples suggest that the graphic format is capable of serious literary achievement.
options: Graphic novels can achieve serious literary depth.
Graphic novels are suitable only for young readers.
Critics have always admired graphic novels.
Maus and Persepolis are about the same historical event.
answer: Graphic novels can achieve serious literary depth.

wrong.Graphic novels are suitable only for you: 這是文中批評者過去的看法，作者隨後用例子反駁。
wrong.Critics have always admired graphic nove: 文章一開始就說批評者曾經輕視圖像小說，always 與文意相反。
wrong.Maus and Persepolis are about the same h: 文中只說兩本書處理戰爭、記憶與認同，並沒有說是同一歷史事件，也不是主旨。

why: 作者先引用舊看法，再用兩部作品作為反證，結論是圖像小說也能有嚴肅的文學成就。
tip: But 之後常是作者真正想表達的觀點。
say: Graphic novels can achieve serious literary depth.

prompt: Based on the text, which choice most logically completes the conclusion?
text: A team measured the average daily screen time of students in two schools. School A students averaged 2.1 hours and School B students averaged 4.3 hours. Both groups took the same reading test, and School A students scored higher on average. The researchers concluded that _____
options: higher screen time may be associated with lower reading scores in this sample.
screen time directly causes lower reading scores for every student.
School A has better teachers than School B.
reading tests are not a reliable measure of anything.
answer: higher screen time may be associated with lower reading scores in this sample.

wrong.screen time directly causes lower readin: 資料只顯示兩校的相關，不能證明因果，也不能推到每一位學生。
wrong.School A has better teachers than School: 文中完全沒有提供老師品質的資料，這是無根據的推測。
wrong.reading tests are not a reliable measure: 研究者使用測驗比較兩組，並沒有質疑測驗本身。

why: 資料只能支持「螢幕時間較高與分數較低有關」這種有限制的結論，不能說因果或推廣到所有人。
tip: 結論別把相關說成因果。
say: Higher screen time may be associated with lower reading scores in this sample.

prompt: Which choice best states the relationship between the two texts?
text: Text 1: Dr. Alvarez argues that remote classes help students learn at their own pace. Text 2: Professor Lin counters that, without in-person contact, many students lose motivation and fall behind.
options: Text 2 disagrees with Text 1 by pointing out a drawback of remote classes.
Text 2 repeats the same argument as Text 1.
Text 2 provides data that proves Text 1 completely correct.
Text 2 changes the subject to in-person sports.
answer: Text 2 disagrees with Text 1 by pointing out a drawback of remote classes.

wrong.Text 2 repeats the same argument as Text: 文本 2 用 counters 表示反駁，立場與文本 1 不同。
wrong.Text 2 provides data that proves Text 1: 文本 2 沒有提供證明文本 1 正確的資料，反而指出缺點。
wrong.Text 2 changes the subject to in-person: 文本 2 仍談遠距課程的學習動機，沒有轉到運動。

why: counters 表示反駁，Lin 指出缺少面對面接觸會讓學生失去動力，與 Alvarez 的優點相對。
tip: counters 是反駁，兩篇通常立場相反。
say: Text 2 disagrees with Text 1 by pointing out a drawback of remote classes.

prompt: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the hypothesis?
text: Marine biologists hypothesize that the reef's fish population declined because rising water temperatures drove the fish to cooler, deeper waters rather than killing them.
options: Surveys at greater depths found more fish of the same species than before.
The number of tourists visiting the reef increased last year.
Water temperatures at the surface were measured at the same level as ten years ago.
Fish at the reef are known to eat algae.
answer: Surveys at greater depths found more fish of the same species than before.

wrong.The number of tourists visiting the reef: 遊客增加與水溫導致魚群移動無直接關聯，不能支持這個假說。
wrong.Water temperatures at the surface were m: 若水溫沒有變，就無法解釋魚為何因升溫而離開，反而削弱假說。
魚吃藻類是背景資訊，無法顯示魚群是否移動到深水。

why: 假說說魚是遷往深水而不是死亡，所以在深水發現同種魚變多是最直接的支持。
tip: 支持假說就找能驗證關鍵機制的證據。
say: Surveys at greater depths found more fish of the same species than before.

prompt: Which choice best summarizes the text?
text: The monarch butterfly travels thousands of miles each autumn from Canada to central Mexico. No single butterfly makes the round trip; instead, several generations complete the journey in stages. Scientists are still studying how the youngest generation knows the way.
options: Monarchs migrate in stages across generations, and how they navigate remains an open question.
Each monarch butterfly flies to Mexico and back in one year.
Scientists have fully explained how monarchs find their way.
Monarchs stay in Canada for the whole winter.
answer: Monarchs migrate in stages across generations, and how they navigate remains an open question.

wrong.Each monarch butterfly flies to Mexico a: 文中明說沒有任何一隻蝴蝶完成來回旅程，要靠好幾代接力。
wrong.Scientists have fully explained how mona: 文章說科學家仍在研究，所以還沒有完全解釋。
wrong.Monarchs stay in Canada for the whole wi: 文中說牠們在秋天前往墨西哥，不是留在加拿大。

why: 摘要要同時包含代代接力遷徙與導航之謎仍未解兩個重點。
tip: 摘要要包含全文主要的兩三個重點。
say: Monarchs migrate in stages across generations, and how they navigate remains an open question.
